passwordSet.subject: Set up your Organza account
passwordSet.preheader: Choose your password to sign in to the store system.
passwordSet.heading: Welcome to Organza
passwordSet.intro: An account has been created for you in the Organza store system. No password was set for you — choose your own using the button below, so nobody else ever knows it.
passwordSet.ignore: If this message reached you by mistake, ignore it and no account will be activated.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your Organza password
passwordReset.preheader: A single-use link to choose a new password.
passwordReset.heading: Reset your password
passwordReset.intro: We received a request to reset the password for your Organza store account. Use the button below to choose a new one.
passwordReset.ignore: If you didn't ask for this, ignore this message — your current password stays as it is.
